description: The slugifier of a file stem: NFC first, then only the letters A to Z are lower-cased; every other character outside [a-z0-9] becomes a hyphen, runs of hyphens collapse, leading and trailing hyphens are trimmed, and an empty result becomes note. The capital I with dot above (U+0130) is therefore a hyphen, never the letter i that Unicode lower-casing would give, so every implementation names an adopted file the same way.
